question: What is the broker/executor config name that controls the number of threads for offloading assignment computation in the Kafka KIP about reducing group coordinator load?

trace.answer:
The broker/executor configuration that controls the number of threads used to offload assignment computation in the Kafka KIP for reducing group coordinator load is **group.coordinator.background.threads**.

**Supporting facts (chronological order)**  
- 2026-03-01T18:33:22.000000Z - Sean Quah (dev) states in a mailing-list reply that the executor config *group.coordinator.executor.threads* has been renamed to *group.coordinator.background.threads*[mail:4f7fd3d7ae5bfb5b7fd2a661].  
- 2026-03-01T18:33:22.000000Z - The same message lists the new name *group.coordinator.background.threads* as the configuration controlling the background executor threads for group coordinator assignment offloading[mail:4f7fd3d7ae5bfb5b7fd2a661].  

**What could not be determined**  
No additional records contradict or modify this configuration name; the information is complete as presented.

Hi all,
During the review of https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/21555, we have
opted to rename the executor configs and metrics.

*Configs*

   - group.coordinator.executor.threads ->
   group.coordinator.background.threads

*Metrics*

   - executor-thread-idle-ratio-avg -> background-thread-idle-ratio-avg
   - executor-queue-time-ms-(p50|p95|p99|p999|max)
   -> background-queue-time-ms-(p50|p95|p99|p999|max)
   - executor-processing-time-ms-(p50|p95|p99|p999|max)
   -> background-processing-time-ms-(p50|p95|p99|p999|max)

Thanks,
Sean
